_method: Each reconstructed room is named from RGB frames taken by the camera standing deepest inside it, the view least likely to be looking out through a doorway. Never from area: area is one of the scored quantities, so naming rooms by area is circular. Frames are in capture/room_identity/<capture>.jpg. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader.
